rules.description: Texas: no statewide sick leave requirement for private employers

source.title: Texas Workforce Commission — Texas Guidebook for Employers: Vacation, Sick, and Parental Leave Policies

versions.notes: TWC: sick and/or parental leave is not required unless it would be a reasonable accommodation under disability- or pregnancy-related laws.

rules.description: Texas minimum wage (Texas Minimum Wage Act adopts the federal FLSA rate)

source.title: U.S. DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated 1 July 2026)

versions.notes: Long-standing rule; in force before this date. Earlier history is not modelled — effectiveFrom is the modelling baseline, not the date the rule was enacted. Texas Labor Code ch. 62 adopts the FLSA section 6 rate by reference.

coverage.notes: No statewide paid sick leave. City paid sick leave ordinances (Austin, Dallas, San Antonio) — legal status not verified; not modelled. No daily overtime.
